title: Flutter (Material 3) — Riverpod, go_router, Dio; notes slice on /v1/notes
lockfile: generated on first install (pubspec.lock is created by flutter create / flutter pub get; commit it after the first green verify)
note: written without a local Flutter SDK; proven by .github/workflows/templates.yml. `flutter create .` only adds missing files (android/, ios/, .metadata, README.md) — it takes the project name from pubspec.yaml and skips existing files such as lib/main.dart and test/widget_test.dart unless --overwrite is passed.
